assets.exact_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: a single transparent PNG magic VFX overlay for a polished animated website; programmatic motion will move, rotate and scale this entire asset.
Primary request: ONE crisp, elegant, sharply defined crescent-shaped wind blade flying toward the RIGHT. The cutting crescent has a pointed leading right edge and only two or three graceful aerodynamic streamlines trailing toward the left. Read instantly as a strong single wind-slash projectile, with substantial visible body at small web sizes.
Style/medium: refined animated feature film magical VFX, high-detail clean luminous airflow sculpted with layered translucent 3D-like ribbons, sharp controlled edges, clear negative space.
Scene/backdrop: genuine RGBA transparency everywhere outside the isolated effect, including the empty interior areas. NO scene or ground.
Composition/framing: square 1024 by 1024 canvas. The whole single effect is centered and fits within the central 76% of the canvas; leave at least 12% completely transparent clear margin on ALL four sides. Keep all tips and particles within that margin. Strong rightward directional silhouette. Do not use a sprite sheet or multiple separate samples.
Color palette: clear pale teal, mint cyan, luminous ivory-white cutting rim, transparent center, subtle richer teal depth, only a few tiny pale gold star flecks. Harmonize with a cream-white, navy-blue and gold character palette, but NO character included.
Lighting/materials: luminous cyan-white rim with finely controlled brightness and transparent airy body, no broad bloom or overexposed halo.
Constraints: exactly one large coherent wind blade, only 2–3 flow tails, no character, no Jingyu, no animal, no face, no text, no letters, no symbols, no logo, no watermark, no border, no checkerboard drawn into the image, no white/black/gray/colored background, no smoke cloud, no oversized glow, no scattered tiny multiple assets. Preserve a real alpha channel.
